title: TapQuest
tagline: Transforming payments and marketing through integrating blockchain, AR, and NFC wearables
how_its_made:
ThreeJS:
At the core of our augmented reality (AR) environment lies ThreeJS, a powerful and versatile JavaScript library. ThreeJS empowers us to overlay captivating digital elements onto the real world, providing users with an interactive and immersive experience. Its flexibility allows for dynamic engagement, surpassing the limitations of traditional formats.

Family ConnectKit:
Facilitating secure and frictionless transactions is the Family Connect Kit. This integral component ensures the smooth management of user wallets, providing a foundation for reliable financial interactions within the TapQuest ecosystem. ConnectKit adds an extra layer of security and user-friendly wallet management, contributing to a trustworthy and streamlined experience.

Aave:
The backbone of our blockchain integration is Aave, a decentralized finance (DeFi) platform. Aave enables micropayments within the AR environment, allowing users to seamlessly pay for virtual goods, unlock exclusive content, or support creators. This integration creates a new revenue stream for both brands and users, redefining transactions in the digital space.

Chainlink Oracles:
Ensuring the accuracy of real-world data is paramount, and that's where Chainlink Oracles come into play. By providing a decentralized oracle network, Chainlink ensures that our platform has access to reliable and verifiable information. This is particularly crucial for the integrity and transparency of transactions within the TapQuest ecosystem.

NextJS:
Powering the frontend of TapQuest is NextJS, a React framework. NextJS allows us to build a fast, scalable, and SEO-friendly application. Its server-side rendering capabilities enhance performance, providing users with a smooth and responsive interface. NextJS contributes to the overall efficiency and user experience of the TapQuest platform.
